title: ADHD vs Non-ADHD Grocery Shopping 😂 #adhd #shorts
desc:
Went in for milk. Came out with 14 things. No milk. 😂 What did YOU forget at the store? 👇

Tip: put the list in your phone, not on the counter, and check it before you hit the register.

#adhd #adhdlife #adhdbrain #adhdproblems #adhdhumor #shorts #relatable #funny

beats.say: Here's how a normal person goes grocery shopping. Bring the list. Get the stuff. Leave.
beats.label: NON-ADHD:

beats.say: Now here's me. I need one thing. Milk. Just milk. I don't even need a list.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: I made a list anyway. Just in case. And I left it on the counter.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Okay, I'm in the store. Ooh. Snacks are on sale.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: I should start cooking more. Let me get stuff for a whole recipe I saw one time.
beats.label: ADHD:
beats.cap: Ingredients for a recipe I saw once.

beats.say: A plant. I don't have plants. I'm a plant person now.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Batteries. Phone charger. Candle that smells like a cabin.
beats.label: ADHD:
beats.cap: Candle that smells like a cabin.

beats.say: Checked out. Eighty seven dollars. I feel great. I'm so prepared.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Get home. Open the fridge. Where's the milk?
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: I didn't get the milk. The one thing. I went there for the milk.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: So I go back. And come home with a cookbook. Still no milk.
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: Here's why. New and shiny wins the fight for your attention every time, and the boring milk loses. So keep the list in your phone, not on the counter. And check it before you get in line. Every time.
beats.cap2: Tip: list in your phone. Check it before the register.

beats.say: What's the one thing you always forget at the store? Tell me in the comments.
